CHAPTER 22 — पत्रलेखनम् (PATRALEKHANAM — LETTER WRITING IN SANSKRIT)

Introduction — पत्रलेखनं किम्?

पत्रलेखनम् (patra-lekhanam) means "letter writing" — पत्रम् (letter) + लेखनम् (writing). A letter is a written message sent to convey news, feelings, requests or information to someone who is not present before us. Even in the age of e-mail and mobile messages, letter writing remains an essential composition skill: it teaches us to organise our thoughts, to address people with the right degree of respect, and to write clear, polite, purposeful sentences. In this lesson (NIOS Secondary Sanskrit, Course 209) we learn how to write simple, correct letters in Sanskrit: the parts of a letter, the difference between informal and formal letters, useful stock phrases, model letters, and the grammar that letter writing specially needs — सम्बोधन-विभक्ति (the vocative) and चतुर्थी विभक्ति (the dative, for the person TO whom the letter goes).

पत्राणां प्रकाराः — Types of letters

Letters are broadly of two kinds:
(1) अनौपचारिकपत्राणि (informal / personal letters) — written to family and friends: मित्राय पत्रम् (letter to a friend), पितृचरणयोः पत्रम् (letter to one's revered father), मातृचरणयोः पत्रम् (to mother), भ्रात्रे पत्रम् (to a brother). Their tone is loving and free; they carry personal news, invitations, congratulations and enquiries of welfare (कुशलप्रश्नः).
(2) औपचारिकपत्राणि (formal / official letters) — written to officials, teachers and institutions: प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम् (request/application to the Principal), अवकाशार्थं पत्रम् (leave application), आवेदनपत्रम् (application letter, e.g. for library membership or a certificate). Their tone is respectful and brief; they follow a fixed format and always state their विषयः (subject) in one line.

पत्रस्य अङ्गानि — Parts of a Sanskrit letter

A well-formed Sanskrit letter has these parts (अङ्गानि):
1. स्थानम् — the place from which the letter is written (e.g. जयपुरनगरम्), written at the top.
2. दिनाङ्कः — the date (e.g. दिनाङ्कः : १०-०८-२०२६), written below the place.
3. सम्बोधनम् — the address/salutation to the recipient, in the vocative: प्रिय मित्र राकेश! (to a friend), पूज्याः पितृचरणाः (to father), मान्याः महोदयाः (to the Principal in a formal letter).
4. विषयः — the subject line, stating the purpose in a few words; used ONLY in formal letters (e.g. विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्).
5. अभिवादनम् — the greeting words: सस्नेहं नमस्ते (to a friend), सादरं प्रणामाः (to elders); in formal letters the body itself opens with सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्... ("my humble submission is that...").
6. पत्रशरीरम् — the body: the actual message in short clear sentences.
7. समापनम् / स्वनिर्देशः — the closing self-description: तव मित्रम् (your friend), भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः (your dear son), भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः (your obedient pupil).
8. हस्ताक्षरम् — the signature (name of the writer), the very last part; in school letters the class and section are added below the name.
In a formal letter, before everything comes the addressee block beginning with सेवायाम् ("In the service of..."), followed by the addressee's designation and the institution's name and place.

उपयोगिनः वाक्यांशाः — Useful phrases for letters

• सादरं प्रणामाः — respectful salutations (to elders such as parents, teachers).
• सस्नेहं नमस्ते — affectionate greetings (to friends and equals).
• शुभाशीर्वादाः — auspicious blessings (an elder writing TO a younger person).
• अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु — "all is well here; may all be well there" — the classic opening of welfare.
• भवतः पत्रं प्राप्तम्, पठित्वा महान् आनन्दः जातः — "I received your letter; reading it gave great joy."
• सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्... — "my humble submission is that..." (opening of a formal request).
• कृपया / कृपां कुर्वन्तु — please / kindly do (honorific plural imperative).
• अनुगृह्णन्तु — "kindly oblige (me)".
• सधन्यवादम् — with thanks.
• अग्रिमपत्रे अधिकं लिखिष्यामि — "I shall write more in the next letter."
• शेषं शुभम् — "the rest is well" (a common closing of the body).
• प्रत्युत्तरं शीघ्रं ददातु / देहि — "please reply soon" (honorific / to a friend).
• मात्रे प्रणामाः, अनुजाय स्नेहः — "salutations to mother, love to the younger brother."

आदर्शपत्राणि — Model letters (original compositions)

MODEL 1 — मित्राय पत्रम् (informal: inviting a friend to a birthday)

जयपुरनगरम्
दिनाङ्कः : १०-०८-२०२६

प्रिय मित्र राकेश!
सस्नेहं नमस्ते।

अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु। तव पत्रं प्राप्तम्। पठित्वा महान् आनन्दः जातः। अग्रिमे सप्ताहे शुक्रवासरे मम जन्मदिवसः अस्ति। तस्मिन् दिने मम गृहे सायं पञ्चवादने लघुः उत्सवः भविष्यति। त्वं मम प्रियं मित्रम् असि, अतः अवश्यम् आगच्छ। सर्वाणि मित्राणि अपि आगमिष्यन्ति। वयं मिलित्वा क्रीडिष्यामः, गीतानि गास्यामः, मोदकानि च खादिष्यामः। शेषं मिलित्वा वदिष्यामि।

तव मित्रम्
रमेशः

English explanation: The place (जयपुरनगरम्) and date come first. The friend is addressed in the vocative — प्रिय मित्र राकेश! — with the affectionate greeting सस्नेहं नमस्ते. Because the friend is an equal, the writer uses त्वम् forms: आगच्छ (come!), तव (your). The closing is तव मित्रम् "your friend" with the signature रमेशः. Note सर्वाणि मित्राणि — मित्रम् is a neuter noun, so "all friends" is neuter plural.

MODEL 2 — पितृचरणयोः पत्रम् (informal: to one's father, asking for money for books)

छात्रावासः, वाराणसी
दिनाङ्कः : ०५-०९-२०२६

पूज्याः पितृचरणाः,
सादरं प्रणामाः।

अत्र सर्वं कुशलम्। अहं नियमेन पठामि, प्रातः व्यायामम् अपि करोमि। आगामिमासे मम अर्धवार्षिकी परीक्षा भविष्यति। परीक्षायाः कृते अहं परिश्रमं करोमि। संस्कृतविषये मम रुचिः दिने दिने वर्धते। नूतनपुस्तकानां क्रयणाय धनस्य आवश्यकता अस्ति। कृपया पञ्चशतरूप्यकाणि शीघ्रं प्रेषयन्तु। मात्रे प्रणामाः, अनुजाय स्नेहः। शेषं शुभम्।

भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः
मोहनः

English explanation: To one's father the salutation is the respectful पूज्याः पितृचरणाः ("revered feet of father" — an idiom of reverence, honorific plural) with सादरं प्रणामाः. Out of respect the son uses honorific plural verbs for his father: प्रेषयन्तु ("may you please send"), and closes with भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः "your (hon. pl.) dear son". चतुर्थी appears in मात्रे प्रणामाः (salutations TO mother) and अनुजाय स्नेहः (love TO the younger brother).

MODEL 3 — प्रधानाचार्याय अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम् (formal: leave application for fever)

सेवायाम्
प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः
राजकीयमाध्यमिकविद्यालयः
जयपुरम्

विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्

मान्याः महोदयाः,
सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं ह्यः रात्रौ ज्वरेण पीडितः अस्मि। वैद्यः मह्यं विश्रामस्य परामर्शं दत्तवान्। अतः अहं विद्यालयम् आगन्तुं न शक्नोमि। कृपया दिनत्रयस्य (१२-०८-२०२६ तः १४-०८-२०२६ पर्यन्तम्) अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु।

सधन्यवादम्।
भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः
सुरेशः
कक्षा — दशमी 'अ'
दिनाङ्कः : १२-०८-२०२६

English explanation: A formal letter opens with सेवायाम् ("in the service of"), then the addressee's designation (प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः, honorific plural), school and place. The विषयः line states the purpose. The salutation मान्याः महोदयाः and the opening सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्... are fixed formal conventions. All verbs referring to the Principal are honorific plural: अनुगृह्णन्तु. The student closes as भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः with name, class and date. The title itself shows चतुर्थी: प्रधानाचार्याय "TO the Principal", अवकाशार्थम् "for the sake of leave".

MODEL 4 — आवेदनपत्रम् (formal: application for library membership, written by a girl student)

सेवायाम्
प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः
सरस्वतीविद्यामन्दिरम्
वाराणसी

विषयः — पुस्तकालयसदस्यतार्थम् आवेदनपत्रम्

मान्याः महोदयाः,
सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं दशम्याः कक्षायाः छात्रा अस्मि। मम पठने महती रुचिः अस्ति। अहं विद्यालयस्य पुस्तकालयात् पुस्तकानि नेतुम् इच्छामि। अतः कृपया मह्यं पुस्तकालयस्य सदस्यतापत्रं ददतु। अहं भवतां कृतज्ञा भविष्यामि।

सधन्यवादम्।
भवताम् आज्ञाकारिणी छात्रा
मीरा
कक्षा — दशमी 'ब'
दिनाङ्कः : २०-०७-२०२६

English explanation: An आवेदनपत्रम् (application) follows the same formal frame: सेवायाम्, addressee block, विषयः, मान्याः महोदयाः, सविनयं निवेदनम्. Because the writer is a girl, the feminine forms appear: छात्रा (girl student), कृतज्ञा (grateful), आज्ञाकारिणी (obedient). चतुर्थी again marks the beneficiary: मह्यं "to me". The honorific plural imperative ददतु ("may you kindly give") shows respect.

व्याकरणम् — Grammar for letter writing

(A) सम्बोधन-विभक्ति (the vocative — calling/addressing). When we directly address someone, the noun takes the vocative form, often with हे or with an exclamation mark: हे मित्र! (O friend!), प्रिय सुरेश! (dear Suresh!), हे राम! For a-stem masculine nouns the vocative singular simply drops the visarga: सुरेशः → हे सुरेश! ; मित्रम् (neuter) → हे मित्र!. Respectful salutations use honorific plurals: पूज्याः पितृचरणाः, मान्याः महोदयाः.

(B) चतुर्थी विभक्ति (the dative — "to/for"). The person TO whom the letter is written, or to whom something is given or conveyed, stands in the dative: मित्राय पत्रम् (a letter TO the friend), प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम् (a request TO the Principal), पित्रे / मात्रे प्रणामाः (salutations TO father / mother), अनुजाय स्नेहः (love TO the younger brother), मह्यं ददतु (give TO me). The word नमः also always takes चतुर्थी: गुरवे नमः (salutation to the teacher). Purpose too takes चतुर्थी-type forms with -अर्थम्: अवकाशार्थम् (for the sake of leave), सदस्यतार्थम् (for membership). Model चतुर्थी forms: बालकः → बालकाय; मित्रम् → मित्राय; पितृ → पित्रे; मातृ → मात्रे; गुरुः → गुरवे; अहम् → मह्यम्.

(C) आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् (honorific plural). Respect is shown by using plural forms for one respected person: भवन्तः (you, honorific), श्रीमन्तः (the honoured one), महोदयाः (sir). The verb then also becomes plural: भवन्तः कृपां कुर्वन्तु (may you kindly do), प्रेषयन्तु (may you send), ददतु (may you give), अनुगृह्णन्तु (may you oblige). To a friend, by contrast, we use simple singular त्वम् forms: त्वम् आगच्छ, त्वं लिख।

SUMMARY (सारांश)

In this chapter you learned that पत्रलेखनम् (letter writing) is a core composition skill with two broad types: अनौपचारिक (informal — to friends and family, free and affectionate) and औपचारिक (formal — to officials and teachers, brief and respectful, with सेवायाम् and a विषयः line). You learned the parts of a Sanskrit letter — स्थानम्, दिनाङ्कः, सम्बोधनम्, विषयः, अभिवादनम्, पत्रशरीरम्, समापनम्, हस्ताक्षरम् — and the stock phrases that fit each relationship: सस्नेहं नमस्ते and तव मित्रम् for a friend; सादरं प्रणामाः and भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः for parents; सविनयं निवेदनम् and भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः for the Principal. You studied four complete model letters — an invitation to a friend, a letter to father, a leave application, and a library-membership application — and the grammar letters need most: सम्बोधन-विभक्ति for addressing (हे मित्र!), चतुर्थी विभक्ति for the recipient (मित्राय, प्रधानाचार्याय, गुरवे नमः), and the honorific plural (भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु) for respect. Practise by writing your own letters on these models.

sections.heading: What letter writing is, and its two types
bullets: पत्रलेखनम् = पत्रम् (letter) + लेखनम् (writing): sending a written message of news, feeling or request to someone not present.
अनौपचारिकपत्राणि (informal) go to friends and family — मित्राय पत्रम्, पितृचरणयोः पत्रम् — with a free, affectionate tone.
औपचारिकपत्राणि (formal) go to officials and teachers — प्रार्थनापत्रम्, अवकाशार्थं पत्रम्, आवेदनपत्रम् — brief, respectful and in a fixed format.
Formal letters always carry a one-line विषयः (subject); informal letters do not.

sections.heading: Parts of a Sanskrit letter
bullets: Top: स्थानम् (place) and दिनाङ्कः (date); in formal letters, first सेवायाम् plus the addressee's designation, institution and place.
सम्बोधनम् (vocative salutation): प्रिय मित्र राकेश! / पूज्याः पितृचरणाः / मान्याः महोदयाः.
अभिवादनम् (greeting): सस्नेहं नमस्ते to a friend, सादरं प्रणामाः to elders; formal body opens with सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्...
End: समापनम् (closing self-description — तव मित्रम्, भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः, भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः) and हस्ताक्षरम् (signature, with class in school letters).

sections.heading: Informal model letters
bullets: To a friend (मित्राय): place/date, प्रिय मित्र...!, सस्नेहं नमस्ते, welfare line अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु, the news or invitation in त्वम् forms (आगच्छ, तव), closing तव मित्रम् + name.

To father (पितृचरणयोः): पूज्याः पितृचरणाः, सादरं प्रणामाः, news of studies, the request with honorific plural (प्रेषयन्तु), greetings to family (मात्रे प्रणामाः, अनुजाय स्नेहः), closing भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः.
With friends use simple singular त्वम् forms; with parents use respectful honorific plurals.
शेषं शुभम् and अग्रिमपत्रे अधिकं लिखिष्यामि are natural informal closings of the body.

sections.heading: Formal letters and applications
bullets: A leave application (अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्) runs: सेवायाम् → addressee block → विषयः → मान्याः महोदयाः → सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्... (reason) → the request (दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु) → सधन्यवादम् → भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः + name, class, date.
An आवेदनपत्रम् (e.g. for library membership) uses the same frame with its own विषयः and request (मह्यं सदस्यतापत्रं ददतु).
All verbs referring to the Principal are honorific plural: कुर्वन्तु, ददतु, अनुगृह्णन्तु.
A girl writer uses feminine forms: छात्रा, आज्ञाकारिणी, कृतज्ञा.

sections.heading: Grammar of address — सम्बोधन, चतुर्थी, honorifics
bullets: सम्बोधन-विभक्ति addresses directly: सुरेशः → हे सुरेश!, मित्रम् → हे मित्र!; respectful salutations are honorific plural (पूज्याः पितृचरणाः).
चतुर्थी विभक्ति marks the recipient: मित्राय पत्रम्, प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम्, पित्रे/मात्रे प्रणामाः, मह्यं ददतु.
नमः always takes चतुर्थी: गुरवे नमः; purpose uses -अर्थम्: अवकाशार्थम्, सदस्यतार्थम्.
आदरार्थे बहुवचनम्: भवन्तः / श्रीमन्तः / महोदयाः with plural verbs (भवन्तः कृपां कुर्वन्तु); to a friend, singular त्वम् (त्वम् आगच्छ).

key_takeaways: पत्रलेखनम् (letter writing) has two broad types: अनौपचारिक (personal — friends, family) and औपचारिक (formal — officials, teachers).
Every Sanskrit letter has fixed parts: स्थानम्, दिनाङ्कः, सम्बोधनम्, (विषयः in formal letters), अभिवादनम्, body, समापनम् and हस्ताक्षरम्.
Match the phrase to the person: सस्नेहं नमस्ते and तव मित्रम् for a friend; सादरं प्रणामाः and भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः for parents; सविनयं निवेदनम् and भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः for the Principal.
A formal letter begins with सेवायाम् and always states its विषयः in one line.
The recipient of a letter stands in चतुर्थी विभक्ति: मित्राय पत्रम्, प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम्; नमः too takes चतुर्थी (गुरवे नमः).
Direct address uses सम्बोधन-विभक्ति: हे मित्र!, प्रिय सुरेश!, मान्याः महोदयाः.
Respect is shown by आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् — भवन्तः, श्रीमन्तः, महोदयाः with plural verbs like कुर्वन्तु and प्रेषयन्तु.

glossary.definition: Letter writing — पत्रम् (letter) + लेखनम् (writing); the skill of composing written messages in Sanskrit.
An informal or personal letter, written to friends and family in a free, affectionate tone (e.g. मित्राय पत्रम्).
A formal or official letter, written to officials, teachers or institutions in a brief, respectful, fixed format.
A request or petition letter, such as a leave application addressed to the Principal (प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम्).
An application letter — e.g. applying for library membership or a certificate — always in the formal format.
Leave or holiday; अवकाशार्थं पत्रम् is a leave application, अवकाशार्थम् meaning 'for the sake of leave'.
The place from which the letter is written, entered at the top of the letter above the date.
The date of writing, entered below the place (in formal school letters often near the signature).
The salutation addressing the recipient in the vocative — प्रिय मित्र!, पूज्याः पितृचरणाः, मान्याः महोदयाः.
The one-line subject stating the purpose of a formal letter, e.g. विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्.
The greeting words after the salutation — सस्नेहं नमस्ते to a friend, सादरं प्रणामाः to elders.
The signature — the writer's name, the last part of the letter; school letters add class and section below it.
'In the service of' — the word that begins the addressee block of a formal letter, before the designation and institution.
'Humble submission' — the fixed opening of the body of a formal request: सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्...
The honorific plural — plural forms (भवन्तः, महोदयाः, कुर्वन्तु) used for one respected person to show respect.

worksheet.title: Worksheet — पत्रलेखनम् (NIOS Sanskrit 209, Chapter 22)
worksheet.instructions: Attempt all questions. Write Sanskrit words and letters in Devanagari; give explanations in English where asked. Follow the letter formats taught in the lesson.

questions.question: पत्रस्य अन्ते किं लिख्यते? (What is written at the very end of a letter?)
questions.explanation: The signature (हस्ताक्षरम्) is the last part of a letter; in school letters the class is added below it.

questions.question: 'मित्राय पत्रम्' — अत्र 'मित्राय' इति पदे का विभक्तिः? (Which case is मित्राय?)
questions.explanation: The recipient of a letter stands in the dative (चतुर्थी): मित्राय = 'to the friend'.

questions.question: पितृचरणयोः पत्रे अभिवादनम् — 'सादरं ________।' (Fill the greeting used for elders.)
questions.explanation: सादरं प्रणामाः — 'respectful salutations' — is the greeting to parents and elders.

questions.question: True or False: विषयः (subject line) is written in a letter to a friend.
questions.explanation: The विषयः line is a feature of formal letters only; informal letters to friends do not carry one.

questions.question: Name six parts (अङ्गानि) of a Sanskrit letter in order, with the English meaning of each.
questions.answer: 1) स्थानम् — place of writing; 2) दिनाङ्कः — date; 3) सम्बोधनम् — salutation to the recipient (e.g. प्रिय मित्र!); 4) अभिवादनम् — greeting (e.g. सादरं प्रणामाः); 5) पत्रशरीरम् — body/message; 6) हस्ताक्षरम् — signature. (Formal letters add सेवायाम् + addressee block and a विषयः line; the closing self-description समापनम् — e.g. तव मित्रम् — comes before the signature.)
questions.explanation: Any six parts in sensible order earn full marks.

questions.question: State any three differences between an औपचारिकपत्रम् (formal letter) and an अनौपचारिकपत्रम् (informal letter).
questions.answer: 1) Recipient: formal letters go to officials/teachers (प्रधानाचार्याय); informal letters go to friends and family (मित्राय, पितृचरणयोः). 2) Format: formal letters begin with सेवायाम् + addressee block and carry a one-line विषयः; informal letters have neither. 3) Tone/phrases: formal letters are brief and respectful (मान्याः महोदयाः, सविनयं निवेदनम्, भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः); informal letters are free and affectionate (प्रिय मित्र!, सस्नेहं नमस्ते, तव मित्रम्).
questions.explanation: Any three correct distinctions of recipient, format, tone, salutation or closing are acceptable.

questions.question: Why does the recipient of a letter take चतुर्थी विभक्ति? Give three examples from the lesson.
questions.answer: चतुर्थी (the dative) expresses 'to/for whom' something is given or directed; since a letter is conveyed TO its recipient, the recipient's name stands in चतुर्थी. Examples: मित्राय पत्रम् (a letter to the friend), प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम् (a request to the Principal), मात्रे प्रणामाः (salutations to mother); also गुरवे नमः, since नमः always takes चतुर्थी.
questions.explanation: Concept (dative = recipient/beneficiary) 1 mark; any three correct examples 2 marks.

questions.question: You need two days' leave for your sister's wedding. Write (a) the विषयः line, (b) the सम्बोधनम्, and (c) one full निवेदन sentence for this application.
questions.answer: (a) विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्। (b) मान्याः महोदयाः, (c) सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् मम भगिन्याः विवाहः अस्ति, अतः कृपया दिनद्वयस्य अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु। (My humble submission is that my sister's wedding is taking place; kindly grant me two days' leave and oblige.)
questions.explanation: Marks for a correct subject line, the formal salutation, and one grammatical निवेदन sentence with the honorific plural.

questions.question: Write a complete leave application in Sanskrit to your Principal (प्रधानाचार्याय अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्) asking for three days' leave because you have fever. Include सेवायाम्, the addressee block, विषयः, salutation, body, and the formal closing with name, class and date.
questions.answer:
सेवायाम्
प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः
राजकीयमाध्यमिकविद्यालयः
जयपुरम्

विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्

मान्याः महोदयाः,
सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं ह्यः रात्रौ ज्वरेण पीडितः अस्मि। वैद्यः मह्यं विश्रामस्य परामर्शं दत्तवान्। अतः अहं विद्यालयम् आगन्तुं न शक्नोमि। कृपया दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु।

सधन्यवादम्।
भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः
सुरेशः
कक्षा — दशमी 'अ'
दिनाङ्कः : १२-०८-२०२६
questions.explanation: Marks for correct format (सेवायाम्, addressee block, विषयः), the formal opening सविनयं निवेदनम्, a clear reason and request in honorific plural, and the proper closing.

questions.question: Write a short informal letter in Sanskrit to your friend inviting him/her to your birthday celebration. Include place, date, salutation, greeting, a 4-5 sentence body and the closing with signature.
questions.answer:
जयपुरनगरम्
दिनाङ्कः : १०-०८-२०२६

प्रिय मित्र राकेश!
सस्नेहं नमस्ते।

अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु। अग्रिमे सप्ताहे शुक्रवासरे मम जन्मदिवसः अस्ति। तस्मिन् दिने मम गृहे सायं पञ्चवादने लघुः उत्सवः भविष्यति। त्वं मम प्रियं मित्रम् असि, अतः अवश्यम् आगच्छ। सर्वाणि मित्राणि अपि आगमिष्यन्ति। वयं मिलित्वा क्रीडिष्यामः, मोदकानि च खादिष्यामः। शेषं मिलित्वा वदिष्यामि।

तव मित्रम्
रमेशः
questions.explanation: Marks for correct informal format (place/date on top, vocative salutation, सस्नेहं नमस्ते), a coherent invitation body in त्वम् forms, and the closing तव मित्रम् with signature.

questions.question: 'पत्रलेखनम्' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः? (What does पत्रलेखनम् mean?)
questions.explanation: पत्रम् (letter) + लेखनम् (writing) = letter writing.

questions.question: पत्राणि मुख्यतः कति प्रकारकाणि? (Letters are broadly of how many types?)
questions.explanation: Two types: अनौपचारिक (informal/personal) and औपचारिक (formal/official).

questions.question: 'औपचारिकपत्रम्' means:
questions.explanation: औपचारिक = formal; such letters go to officials, teachers and institutions.

questions.question: अनौपचारिकपत्रं कस्मै लिख्यते? (To whom is an informal letter written?)
questions.explanation: Informal (personal) letters go to friends and family — मित्राय, पितृचरणयोः, मातृचरणयोः.

questions.question: An अवकाशार्थं पत्रम् (leave application) is which type of letter?
options: It is not a letter at all
questions.explanation: A leave application is addressed to the Principal, an official — hence formal.

questions.question: मित्राय लिखितं पत्रं किम् अस्ति? (A letter written to a friend is...?)
questions.explanation: A letter to a friend is personal, hence informal (अनौपचारिक).

questions.question: 'प्रार्थनापत्रम्' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: प्रार्थना = request/prayer; a प्रार्थनापत्रम् petitions an authority, e.g. for leave.

questions.question: Why is letter writing still an important skill in the age of e-mail?
options: It teaches ordered thought, right forms of respect and clear polite expression
Because e-mail does not reach villages
Because letters are cheaper than stamps
questions.answer: It teaches ordered thought, right forms of respect and clear polite expression
questions.explanation: The lesson stresses that letter writing trains organisation, appropriate address and polite, purposeful sentences.

questions.question: पत्रे लेखनस्थानं यत्र सूच्यते तत् अङ्गं किम्? (Which part of a letter shows the place of writing?)
questions.explanation: स्थानम् (e.g. जयपुरनगरम्) is written at the top of the letter.

questions.question: 'दिनाङ्कः' इति पत्राङ्गं किं सूचयति?
questions.explanation: दिनाङ्कः = date; it is written below the place (or near the signature in formal school letters).

questions.question: The part of a letter in which the recipient is addressed (e.g. प्रिय मित्र राकेश!) is called:
questions.explanation: सम्बोधनम् is the salutation, written in the vocative case.

questions.question: 'विषयः' इति अङ्गं कस्मिन् पत्रे लिख्यते? (In which letter is the विषयः line written?)
options: औपचारिकपत्रे एव (only in a formal letter)
अनौपचारिकपत्रे एव (only in an informal letter)
questions.answer: औपचारिकपत्रे एव (only in a formal letter)
questions.explanation: The one-line subject (विषयः) is a fixed feature of formal letters only.

questions.question: 'सादरं प्रणामाः' / 'सस्नेहं नमस्ते' इत्यादीनि वचनानि पत्रस्य कस्मिन् अङ्गे आयान्ति?
questions.explanation: The greeting words form the अभिवादनम् part, coming after the सम्बोधनम्.

questions.question: 'हस्ताक्षरम्' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: हस्ताक्षरम् = signature (हस्त = hand, अक्षरम् = letters); the writer's name at the end.

questions.question: अनौपचारिकपत्रे स्थानं दिनाङ्कः च कुत्र लिख्येते? (Where are the place and date written in an informal letter?)
options: At the top of the letter
At the very end after the signature
In the middle of the body
questions.answer: At the top of the letter
questions.explanation: स्थानम् and दिनाङ्कः head the letter, before the salutation.

questions.question: औपचारिकपत्रस्य आरम्भे किं पदं लिख्यते? (With which word does a formal letter begin?)
questions.explanation: सेवायाम् ('in the service of') opens the addressee block of every formal letter.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the विषयः line in a formal letter?
options: To state the letter's purpose briefly in one line
To give the writer's home address
questions.answer: To state the letter's purpose briefly in one line
questions.explanation: विषयः summarises the subject, e.g. विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्।

questions.question: In a student's leave application, the class and section (कक्षा — दशमी 'अ') are written:
options: Below the signature at the end
questions.answer: Below the signature at the end
questions.explanation: The student signs, then adds class/section and the date below the name.

questions.question: प्रधानाचार्याय लिखिते पत्रे सम्बोधनं किं भवति? (What is the salutation in a letter to the Principal?)
questions.explanation: The respectful formal salutation to the Principal is मान्याः महोदयाः (honorific plural).

questions.question: 'पत्रशरीरम्' इति अङ्गे किं लिख्यते? (What is written in the पत्रशरीरम्?)
options: The actual message of the letter in clear sentences
The address of the post office
questions.answer: The actual message of the letter in clear sentences
questions.explanation: पत्रशरीरम् ('body of the letter') carries the news, request or invitation itself.

questions.question: मित्राय पत्रे उचितं सम्बोधनं किम्? (Which salutation suits a letter to a friend?)
questions.explanation: A friend is addressed affectionately in the vocative: प्रिय मित्र...!

questions.question: पितृचरणयोः पत्रे उचितम् अभिवादनं किम्? (Which greeting suits a letter to one's father?)
questions.explanation: To elders like parents the respectful greeting is सादरं प्रणामाः.

questions.question: मित्राय पत्रस्य समापने किं लिख्यते? (Which closing suits a letter to a friend?)
questions.explanation: The friendly closing is तव मित्रम् ('your friend') followed by the name.

questions.question: पितृचरणयोः पत्रस्य समापने पुत्रः किं लिखति? (How does a son close a letter to his father?)
questions.explanation: The son closes with भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः — 'your (honorific) dear son'.

questions.question: मित्राय पत्रे मित्रस्य कृते किं सर्वनाम युज्यते? (Which pronoun is used for the friend in an informal letter?)
questions.explanation: Friends are equals, so the simple singular त्वम् (with verbs like आगच्छ, लिख) is used.

questions.question: 'अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु' इत्यस्य कः भावः?
options: All is well here; may all be well there
questions.answer: All is well here; may all be well there
questions.explanation: This classic welfare line opens the body of informal letters.

questions.question: मातृचरणयोः पत्रे उचितं सम्बोधनं किम्? (Which salutation suits a letter to one's mother?)
questions.explanation: On the model of पूज्याः पितृचरणाः, the mother is addressed as पूज्याः मातृचरणाः.

questions.question: An elder writing a reply TO a younger person would greet with:
questions.explanation: Elders send blessings (शुभाशीर्वादाः) to the young; प्रणामाः go upward, आशीर्वादाः come downward.

questions.question: अवकाशप्राप्त्यर्थं प्रधानाचार्याय लिखितं पत्रं किं कथ्यते? (What is a letter to the Principal asking for leave called?)
questions.explanation: A leave application is अवकाशार्थं (for leave) प्रार्थनापत्रम् (request letter).

questions.question: 'सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्...' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: सविनयम् = with humility; निवेदनम् = submission/request — the fixed formal opening.

questions.question: प्रार्थनापत्रस्य समापने छात्रः किं लिखति? (How does a student close an application?)
questions.explanation: The formal closing is भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः/छात्रः — 'your obedient pupil'.

questions.question: 'आवेदनपत्रम्' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: आवेदनम् = application; an आवेदनपत्रम् formally applies for something (membership, certificate etc.).

questions.question: 'दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशम्' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
options: The third day of the month
questions.explanation: दिनत्रयम् = a set of three days; दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशः = three days' leave.

questions.question: प्रधानाचार्यविषये औपचारिकपत्रे कीदृशं क्रियापदं युज्यते? (Which verb form is used for the Principal in a formal letter?)
questions.explanation: Respect demands आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् — plural imperatives like कुर्वन्तु, ददतु, अनुगृह्णन्तु.

questions.question: 'अवकाशः' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: अवकाशः means leave or holiday; hence अवकाशार्थं पत्रम् = leave application.

questions.question: Which of these parts is normally NOT found in an informal letter to a friend?
questions.explanation: The विषयः line belongs to formal letters only.

questions.question: 'सधन्यवादम्' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: स + धन्यवादम् = 'with thanks' — written before the formal closing.

questions.question: पुस्तकालयसदस्यतां प्राप्तुं छात्रा किं पत्रं लिखेत्? (Which letter should a girl student write to get library membership?)
questions.explanation: Applying for membership needs a formal आवेदनपत्रम् to the Principal.

questions.question: 'सादरं प्रणामाः' इति कस्मै युज्यते? (For whom is सादरं प्रणामाः used?)
options: For elders such as parents and teachers
For a close friend of the same age
questions.answer: For elders such as parents and teachers
questions.explanation: सादरं प्रणामाः = 'respectful salutations', offered to elders.

questions.question: 'सस्नेहं नमस्ते' इति कस्मै युज्यते?
questions.explanation: सस्नेहम् = with affection; this greeting suits friends and equals.

questions.question: 'भवतः पत्रं प्राप्तम्' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: भवतः = your (honorific); प्राप्तम् = received.

questions.question: 'शेषं शुभम्' इत्यस्य कः भावः?
questions.explanation: शेषम् = the remainder; शुभम् = well/auspicious — a common closing of the body.

questions.question: 'कृपया' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: कृपया ('by kindness') = please; central to polite requests.

questions.question: 'अग्रिमपत्रे अधिकं लिखिष्यामि' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
options: I shall write more in the next letter
I have written too much already
questions.answer: I shall write more in the next letter
questions.explanation: अग्रिमपत्रे = in the next letter; अधिकम् = more; लिखिष्यामि = I shall write.

questions.question: 'भवदीयः' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: भवदीयः = 'yours' (from भवत्), a respectful closing self-description.

questions.question: 'प्रत्युत्तरं शीघ्रं ददातु' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: प्रत्युत्तरम् = reply; शीघ्रम् = soon; ददातु = may (you) give (respectful imperative).

questions.question: 'मात्रे प्रणामाः, अनुजाय स्नेहः' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
options: Salutations to mother, love to the younger brother
Mother sends love to the brother
Salute the mother of my friend
questions.answer: Salutations to mother, love to the younger brother
questions.explanation: मात्रे (चतुर्थी of मातृ) = to mother; अनुजाय = to the younger brother.

questions.question: 'पठित्वा महान् आनन्दः जातः' इत्यस्य कः अर्थः?
questions.explanation: पठित्वा = having read; आनन्दः जातः = joy arose.

questions.question: 'अनुगृह्णन्तु' इति पदस्य कः भावः?
questions.explanation: From अनु + ग्रह् — 'to favour/oblige'; the honorific plural imperative closes a formal request.

questions.question: 'कुशलप्रश्नः' इति किम्? (What is a कुशलप्रश्नः in a letter?)
options: An enquiry after the recipient's welfare
questions.answer: An enquiry after the recipient's welfare
questions.explanation: कुशलम् = welfare; asking after well-being (as in अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु) is the कुशलप्रश्नः.

questions.question: औपचारिक-अनौपचारिकपत्रयोः मुख्यः भेदः कः? (What is the main difference between formal and informal letters?)
options: Formal letters have a fixed respectful format with सेवायाम् and विषयः; informal letters are free and personal
Formal letters are always longer than informal ones
Informal letters cannot be written in Sanskrit
Formal letters never carry a date
questions.answer: Formal letters have a fixed respectful format with सेवायाम् and विषयः; informal letters are free and personal
questions.explanation: The difference lies in recipient, tone and format — not length or language.

questions.question: Which salutation-greeting pair correctly suits an INFORMAL letter?
questions.explanation: The affectionate vocative and greeting go together in a friend's letter.

questions.question: Which pair correctly belongs to a FORMAL letter?
questions.explanation: मान्याः महोदयाः with सविनयं निवेदनम् is the formal convention for officials.

questions.question: आवेदनपत्रं कस्मै लिख्यते? (To whom is an आवेदनपत्रम् addressed?)
options: To an official or institution head, e.g. the Principal
questions.answer: To an official or institution head, e.g. the Principal
questions.explanation: Applications are formal letters addressed to authorities.

questions.question: A letter sharing personal news of home and studies with one's father is:
questions.explanation: Family letters carrying personal news are informal, however respectful their tone.

questions.question: औपचारिकपत्रस्य भाषा कीदृशी भवेत्? (What should the language of a formal letter be like?)
options: Brief, polite and to the point
questions.answer: Brief, polite and to the point
questions.explanation: Formal letters state their purpose respectfully in few clear sentences.

questions.question: Which of these closings is FORMAL?
questions.explanation: 'Your obedient pupil' is the formal closing to the Principal; the others are personal.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an INFORMAL letter?
questions.explanation: A birthday invitation to a friend is personal; the other three are formal requests.

questions.question: 'प्रधानाचार्याय' इति पदे का विभक्तिः?
questions.explanation: The dative -आय marks the recipient: 'TO the Principal'.

questions.question: 'मित्रम्' इत्यस्य सम्बोधने किं रूपम्? (What is the vocative of मित्रम्?)
questions.explanation: The vocative drops the ending: मित्रम् → हे मित्र!

questions.question: आदरं प्रदर्शयितुं 'त्वम्' स्थाने किं पदं युज्यते? (Which word replaces त्वम् to show respect?)
questions.explanation: भवन्तः is the honorific plural 'you', used for respected persons.

questions.question: 'नमः' इति पदेन सह का विभक्तिः युज्यते? (Which case is used with नमः?)
questions.explanation: नमः governs the dative: गुरवे नमः, रामाय नमः.

questions.question: 'पितृ' शब्दस्य चतुर्थी-एकवचने किं रूपम्? (What is the dative singular of पितृ?)
questions.explanation: पितृ → पित्रे 'to father', as in पित्रे प्रणामाः.

questions.question: 'सुरेशः' इत्यस्य सम्बोधने किं रूपम्?
questions.explanation: A-stem masculine vocative singular drops the visarga: सुरेशः → हे सुरेश!

questions.question: 'भवन्तः' इति पदेन सह क्रियापदं कीदृशं भवति? (What form does the verb take with भवन्तः?)
questions.explanation: The honorific plural subject takes a plural verb: भवन्तः कृपां कुर्वन्तु.

questions.question: 'बालकः' इत्यस्य चतुर्थी-एकवचने किं रूपम्?
questions.explanation: A-stem dative singular ends in -आय: बालकाय = 'to the boy'.

questions.question: 'श्रीमन्तः' इति पदं पत्रे किमर्थं युज्यते? (Why is श्रीमन्तः used in a letter?)
options: As an honorific plural of respect for one distinguished person
To address many rich people together
As the name of a festival
questions.answer: As an honorific plural of respect for one distinguished person
questions.explanation: Like भवन्तः and महोदयाः, श्रीमन्तः is आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् — respect through the plural.

questions.question: 'गुरु' शब्दस्य चतुर्थी-एकवचने किं रूपम्? (Dative singular of गुरुः?)
questions.explanation: गुरुः → गुरवे, as in the salutation गुरवे नमः.

questions.question: 'मह्यम्' इति कस्य पदस्य चतुर्थीरूपम्? (मह्यम् is the dative of which word?)
questions.explanation: अहम् → मह्यम् 'to me', as in कृपया मह्यं सदस्यतापत्रं ददतु.

questions.question: 'अवकाशार्थम्' इति पदे '-अर्थम्' किं सूचयति? (What does -अर्थम् indicate in अवकाशार्थम्?)
questions.explanation: -अर्थम् expresses purpose, a dative-type sense: अवकाशार्थम्, सदस्यतार्थम्.

questions.question: यस्य पत्रस्य सम्बोधनं 'पूज्याः पितृचरणाः' अस्ति, तत् पत्रं कस्मै लिखितम्? (A letter whose salutation is पूज्याः पितृचरणाः is addressed to whom?)
questions.explanation: पूज्याः पितृचरणाः ('revered feet of father') marks a letter to one's father.

questions.question: A letter contains the line 'विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्'. What can we conclude?
options: It is a formal leave application
It is a birthday invitation to a friend
It is a letter of blessings from a grandfather
It is a thank-you note to one's mother
questions.answer: It is a formal leave application
questions.explanation: Only formal letters carry a विषयः, and this subject line names a leave request.

questions.question: पत्रान्ते 'तव मित्रम्, रमेशः' इति लिखितम् — अत्र रमेशः कः? (At the end of a letter stands 'तव मित्रम्, रमेशः' — who is रमेशः?)
questions.explanation: The name below the closing is the signature — the sender, writing as 'your friend'.

questions.question: You are writing to the Principal for three days' leave due to fever. Which विषयः line is correct?
questions.explanation: The subject must name the purpose — a request for leave.

questions.question: A student begins a letter to his friend thus: 'प्रिय मित्र! सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्...'. What is wrong here?
options: सविनयं निवेदनम् is a formal phrase and does not fit a friend's letter
प्रिय मित्र is a formal salutation and does not fit
Nothing is wrong; the sentence is perfect
A letter can never begin with a salutation
questions.answer: सविनयं निवेदनम् is a formal phrase and does not fit a friend's letter
questions.explanation: To a friend one writes सस्नेहं नमस्ते and free personal sentences; सविनयं निवेदनम् belongs to formal applications.

questions.question: True or False: 'पत्रलेखनम्' means letter writing (पत्रम् + लेखनम्).
questions.explanation: पत्रम् = letter, लेखनम् = writing; together 'letter writing'.

questions.question: True or False: A letter to a friend must contain a विषयः (subject) line.
questions.explanation: The विषयः line is used only in formal letters, not in personal letters to friends.

questions.question: True or False: A formal letter begins with the word सेवायाम्.
questions.explanation: सेवायाम् ('in the service of') opens the addressee block of formal letters.

questions.question: True or False: 'सादरं प्रणामाः' is the greeting used for a friend of one's own age.
questions.explanation: सादरं प्रणामाः is for elders; a friend receives सस्नेहं नमस्ते.

questions.question: True or False: In 'मित्राय पत्रं लिखामि', the word मित्राय is in चतुर्थी विभक्ति.
questions.explanation: मित्राय ('to the friend') is dative — the case of the recipient.

questions.question: True or False: With the honorific भवन्तः, the verb remains singular, e.g. 'भवन्तः कुरु'.
questions.explanation: भवन्तः takes a plural verb: भवन्तः कुर्वन्तु, never कुरु.

questions.question: True or False: A leave application to the Principal is an informal letter.
questions.explanation: It is addressed to an authority in a fixed format — hence formal.

questions.question: True or False: The signature (हस्ताक्षरम्) comes at the end of the letter.
questions.explanation: The writer's name closes the letter, after the समापन line like तव मित्रम्.

questions.question: True or False: In a letter to his father, a son may close with 'भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः'.
questions.explanation: 'Your dear son' (with honorific भवताम्) is the proper affectionate-respectful closing.

questions.question: True or False: 'तव मित्रम्' is an appropriate closing for a leave application to the Principal.
questions.explanation: A formal application closes with भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः; तव मित्रम् is for friends.

questions.question: पितुः कृते पत्रे सम्बोधनम् — 'पूज्याः ________।' (Fill the salutation word for a letter to father.)
questions.explanation: पूज्याः पितृचरणाः — 'revered feet of father' — the respectful salutation.

questions.question: औपचारिकपत्रस्य आरम्भवाक्यम् — 'सविनयं ________ अस्ति यत्...' (Fill the blank.)
questions.explanation: सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्... = 'my humble submission is that...'

questions.question: औपचारिकपत्रं '________' इति पदेन आरभ्यते, ततः प्रेषितव्यस्य पदनाम लिख्यते। (A formal letter begins with this word.)
questions.explanation: सेवायाम् — 'in the service of' — heads the addressee block.

questions.question: प्रार्थनापत्रस्य समापनम् — 'भवताम् आज्ञाकारी ________।' (Fill the word the student writes before his name.)
questions.explanation: भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः = 'your obedient pupil'. (छात्रः is also seen; the model uses शिष्यः.)

questions.question: गुरुजनेभ्यः अभिवादनम् — 'सादरं ________।' (Fill the greeting word for elders.)
questions.explanation: सादरं प्रणामाः — respectful salutations to elders.

questions.question: मित्राय अभिवादनम् — 'सस्नेहं ________।' (Fill the greeting word for a friend.)
questions.explanation: सस्नेहं नमस्ते — affectionate greetings between friends.

questions.question: कुशलप्रश्नवाक्यम् — 'अत्र कुशलं ________।' (Complete the classic welfare line.)
questions.explanation: अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु — 'all is well here; may all be well there'.

questions.question: 'मित्रम्' शब्दस्य चतुर्थी-एकवचनरूपं लिखत — 'to the friend' = ________ (यथा — ________ पत्रं लिखामि)। One word.
questions.explanation: मित्रम् → मित्राय (dative singular): मित्राय पत्रं लिखामि।

questions.question: रिक्तस्थानं पूरयत — 'गुरवे ________।' (Salutation to the teacher; नमः takes चतुर्थी.)
questions.explanation: गुरवे नमः — the word नमः always governs the dative.

questions.question: 'प्रधानाचार्यः' शब्दस्य चतुर्थीरूपं लिखत — '________ प्रार्थनापत्रम्' (a request TO the Principal). One word.
questions.explanation: The recipient stands in चतुर्थी: प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम्।

questions.question: यस्मिन् अङ्गे पत्रलेखनदिनाङ्कः लिख्यते तस्य नाम — ________। (Name the part that records the date. One word.)
questions.explanation: दिनाङ्कः is the date part, written below the स्थानम्.

questions.question: पत्रस्य अन्ते लेखकः स्वनाम यत् लिखति तत् अङ्गम् — ________। (The signature part of a letter. One word.)
questions.explanation: हस्ताक्षरम् — the signature, last part of the letter.

questions.question: औपचारिकपत्रे प्रयोजनसूचकं एकवाक्यम् अङ्गम् — ________। (The one-line purpose part of a formal letter. One word.)
questions.explanation: विषयः states the subject/purpose in one line, e.g. विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्।

questions.question: पत्रशरीरस्य अन्ते लिख्यते — 'शेषं ________।' ('The rest is well.' Fill one word.)
questions.explanation: शेषं शुभम् — a common closing line of the letter body.

questions.question: मित्राय पत्रस्य समापनम् — 'तव ________, रमेशः।' (Fill the friendly closing word.)
questions.explanation: तव मित्रम् — 'your friend' — the informal closing before the signature.

questions.question: What is पत्रलेखनम्? Why is it still an important skill today? Answer in 2-3 sentences.
questions.answer: पत्रलेखनम् (पत्रम् + लेखनम्) is the skill of writing letters — written messages of news, feeling or request sent to someone not present. It remains important because it trains us to organise thoughts, to address people with the right degree of respect (friend vs father vs Principal), and to write clear, polite, purposeful sentences — skills that carry over to e-mails and applications today.
questions.explanation: Definition 1 mark; importance 1 mark.

questions.question: Name the two broad types of letters with one Sanskrit example of each.
questions.answer: 1) अनौपचारिकपत्रम् (informal/personal letter) — e.g. मित्राय पत्रम् (letter to a friend) or पितृचरणयोः पत्रम् (letter to father). 2) औपचारिकपत्रम् (formal/official letter) — e.g. प्रधानाचार्याय अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम् (leave application to the Principal) or आवेदनपत्रम् (application letter).
questions.explanation: One mark per type with a valid example.

questions.question: पत्रस्य षड् अङ्गानि नामतः लिखत। (Name six parts of a Sanskrit letter, with English meanings.)
questions.answer: स्थानम् (place of writing), दिनाङ्कः (date), सम्बोधनम् (salutation to the recipient), अभिवादनम् (greeting words), पत्रशरीरम् (body/message) and हस्ताक्षरम् (signature). Formal letters additionally have सेवायाम् with the addressee block and a विषयः (subject) line; the समापनम् (closing self-description like तव मित्रम्) comes just before the signature.
questions.explanation: Half a mark per correct part; any six parts accepted.

questions.question: What is written in the सम्बोधनम् of a letter? Give one example each for a friend and for the Principal.
questions.answer: The सम्बोधनम् addresses the recipient directly in the vocative case, showing the right degree of affection or respect. To a friend: प्रिय मित्र राकेश! (with सस्नेहं नमस्ते following). To the Principal in a formal letter: मान्याः महोदयाः (honorific plural).
questions.explanation: Concept 1 mark; two correct examples 1 mark.

questions.question: Where is the विषयः written in a formal letter, and why is it useful?
questions.answer: The विषयः is written as a single line after the सेवायाम्-addressee block and before the salutation मान्याः महोदयाः. It states the letter's purpose in a few words (e.g. विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्), so a busy official knows at a glance what the letter asks, making the letter brief and easy to act upon.
questions.explanation: Position 1 mark; usefulness 1 mark.

questions.question: Write the correct सम्बोधनम् and अभिवादनम् for a letter to your father.
questions.answer: सम्बोधनम् — पूज्याः पितृचरणाः ('revered feet of father', honorific plural). अभिवादनम् — सादरं प्रणामाः ('respectful salutations').
questions.explanation: One mark for each correct element.

questions.question: Write any two suitable opening sentences (after the greeting) for an informal letter to your friend, in Sanskrit.
questions.answer: For example: 1) अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु। ('All is well here; may all be well there.') 2) तव पत्रं प्राप्तम्, पठित्वा महान् आनन्दः जातः। ('I received your letter; reading it gave me great joy.') Other correct welfare/news openings are acceptable.
questions.explanation: Any two grammatical, contextually apt sentences earn full marks.

questions.question: How do the closings of a letter to a friend and a letter to one's father differ? Write both closings.
questions.answer: To a friend the closing is simple and affectionate: तव मित्रम्, रमेशः ('your friend, Ramesh') — with the singular तव. To one's father it is respectful: भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः, मोहनः ('your dear son, Mohan') — with the honorific plural भवताम्.
questions.explanation: Both closings correct with the तव/भवताम् contrast noted.

questions.question: What is an अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्? Outline its structure briefly.
questions.answer: It is a formal leave application — a request letter (प्रार्थनापत्रम्) to the Principal asking for leave (अवकाशार्थम्). Structure: (1) सेवायाम् + addressee block (designation, school, place); (2) विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्; (3) salutation मान्याः महोदयाः; (4) body opening with सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्..., giving the reason and the exact days of leave requested; (5) सधन्यवादम्; (6) closing भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः with name, class and date.
questions.explanation: Definition 1 mark; structure in order 2 marks.

questions.question: What does सेवायाम् mean, and where exactly is it used?
questions.answer: सेवायाम् literally means 'in the service (of)' — it is the locative of सेवा (service). It is written as the very first word of a formal letter, at the head of the addressee block, followed by the recipient's designation and institution: सेवायाम् / प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः / राजकीयमाध्यमिकविद्यालयः / जयपुरम्।
questions.explanation: Meaning 1 mark; position/usage 1 mark.

questions.question: Write the विषयः line (in Sanskrit) for: (a) a three-day leave application; (b) an application for library membership.
questions.answer: (a) विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्। (b) विषयः — पुस्तकालयसदस्यतार्थम् आवेदनपत्रम्।
questions.explanation: One mark per correct subject line.

questions.question: What does 'सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्' mean, and in which kind of letter is it used?
questions.answer: It means 'my humble submission is that...' (सविनयम् = with humility/politeness; निवेदनम् = submission, request). It is the fixed opening sentence of the body of a FORMAL letter — a प्रार्थनापत्रम् or आवेदनपत्रम् addressed to an authority such as the Principal. It is not used in letters to friends or family.
questions.explanation: Meaning 1 mark; correct context 1 mark.

questions.question: Give any four useful letter-writing phrases in Sanskrit with their English meanings.
questions.answer: For example: 1) अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु — all is well here; may all be well there. 2) भवतः पत्रं प्राप्तम् — I received your letter. 3) शेषं शुभम् — the rest is well. 4) सधन्यवादम् — with thanks. (Also acceptable: सादरं प्रणामाः — respectful salutations; सस्नेहं नमस्ते — affectionate greetings; कृपां कुर्वन्तु — kindly do; अनुगृह्णन्तु — kindly oblige; अग्रिमपत्रे अधिकं लिखिष्यामि — I shall write more in the next letter.)
questions.explanation: Any four phrases with correct meanings; three-quarters of a mark each.

questions.question: Explain the meaning and use of 'अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु'.
questions.answer: It means 'here (with me) all is well; may it be well there (with you) too' — अत्र = here, कुशलम् = welfare, तत्र = there, अस्तु = may it be. It is the traditional welfare line (कुशलप्रश्नः) that opens the body of an informal letter, assuring the reader of the writer's well-being and wishing them the same.
questions.explanation: Word-meaning 1 mark; use 1 mark.

questions.question: State three differences between formal (औपचारिक) and informal (अनौपचारिक) letters, with examples of the phrases used in each.
questions.answer: 1) Recipient: formal letters go to authorities (प्रधानाचार्याय); informal to friends/family (मित्राय, पितृचरणयोः). 2) Format: formal letters carry सेवायाम् + addressee block and a विषयः line; informal letters begin simply with place, date and salutation. 3) Tone and phrases: formal — मान्याः महोदयाः, सविनयं निवेदनम्, सधन्यवादम्, भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः; informal — प्रिय मित्र!, सस्नेहं नमस्ते / सादरं प्रणामाः, शेषं शुभम्, तव मित्रम् / भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः.
questions.explanation: One mark per contrast with correct examples.

questions.question: Why should a formal letter be brief and polite? Answer in 2-3 sentences.
questions.answer: A formal letter is read by a busy official who must act on it — a brief letter with a clear विषयः lets the purpose be grasped and granted quickly. Politeness (सविनयं निवेदनम्, honorific plurals like कुर्वन्तु) shows proper respect for the authority's position and makes the request worthy of a favourable reply. Rambling or casual language would obscure the request and appear disrespectful.
questions.explanation: Any two sound reasons (clarity, respect, effectiveness).

questions.question: Why does the recipient of a letter stand in चतुर्थी विभक्ति? Give three examples from this lesson.
questions.answer: चतुर्थी (the dative case) expresses the sense 'to/for whom' — the beneficiary or recipient of an action. Since a letter, a salutation or love is directed TO someone, that person's noun takes चतुर्थी. Examples: मित्राय पत्रम् (a letter to the friend), प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम् (a request to the Principal), मात्रे प्रणामाः (salutations to mother), अनुजाय स्नेहः (love to the younger brother), गुरवे नमः (salutation to the teacher — नमः always takes चतुर्थी).
questions.explanation: Concept 1 mark; any three correct examples 2 marks.

questions.question: What is सम्बोधन-विभक्ति? Show it with the vocative forms of सुरेशः and मित्रम्.
questions.answer: सम्बोधन-विभक्ति is the vocative — the form a noun takes when the person is directly addressed or called, often with हे or an exclamation. For a-stem masculine nouns the visarga is dropped: सुरेशः → हे सुरेश! ; for the neuter मित्रम् → हे मित्र! (as in the salutation प्रिय मित्र राकेश!).
questions.explanation: Definition 1 mark; both forms correct 1 mark.

questions.question: What is आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् (honorific plural)? Explain with भवन्तः and two verb examples from the model letters.
questions.answer: आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् is the use of PLURAL forms for a single respected person to show honour. Instead of त्वम् one says भवन्तः (or श्रीमन्तः / महोदयाः), and the verb also becomes plural. From the models: कृपया पञ्चशतरूप्यकाणि प्रेषयन्तु ('kindly send 500 rupees' — the son to his father) and कृपया अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु ('kindly grant leave and oblige me' — the student to the Principal); likewise ददतु, कुर्वन्तु. To a friend, by contrast, the simple singular is used: त्वम् आगच्छ।
questions.explanation: Concept 1 mark; भवन्तः + plural-verb agreement 1 mark; valid examples 1 mark.

questions.question: Arrange these jumbled parts of a formal letter in the correct order: हस्ताक्षरम्, विषयः, सेवायाम्, सविनयं निवेदनम्, मान्याः महोदयाः, सधन्यवादम्।
questions.answer: Correct order: 1) सेवायाम् (with the addressee block), 2) विषयः, 3) मान्याः महोदयाः (salutation), 4) सविनयं निवेदनम् (opening of the body), 5) सधन्यवादम् (thanks), 6) हस्ताक्षरम् (signature, with class and date).
questions.explanation: Half a mark per correctly placed part.

questions.question: Find and correct the TWO errors of convention in this extract of a leave application: 'प्रिय मित्र प्रधानाचार्य! सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं ज्वरपीडितः अस्मि। ... तव मित्रम्, सुरेशः।'
questions.answer: Error 1 — the salutation: a Principal cannot be addressed as प्रिय मित्र...!; the formal salutation must be मान्याः महोदयाः (after सेवायाम् and the विषयः line). Error 2 — the closing: तव मित्रम् is an informal closing; the application must close with भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः, सुरेशः (with class and date). The body phrase सविनयं निवेदनम् is correct as it stands.
questions.explanation: One and a half marks per error found and correctly fixed.

questions.question: A letter has the salutation 'पूज्याः मातृचरणाः' and the closing 'भवतीनां प्रिया पुत्री, लता'. Identify (a) the type of letter, (b) the writer and the recipient.
questions.answer: (a) It is an अनौपचारिकपत्रम् (informal/personal family letter). (b) The writer is a daughter named लता (प्रिया पुत्री — 'dear daughter', feminine), and the recipient is her mother (पूज्याः मातृचरणाः; भवतीनाम् is the feminine honorific plural 'your').
questions.explanation: Type 1 mark; writer and recipient correctly identified 1 mark.

questions.question: स्वजन्मदिवसोत्सवे मित्रं निमन्त्रयितुं संस्कृतभाषया एकं पत्रं लिखत। (Write a complete Sanskrit letter inviting your friend to your birthday celebration — with place, date, salutation, greeting, body of 4-5 sentences, and closing with signature.)
questions.answer:
जयपुरनगरम्
दिनाङ्कः : १०-०८-२०२६

प्रिय मित्र राकेश!
सस्नेहं नमस्ते।

अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु। अग्रिमे सप्ताहे शुक्रवासरे मम जन्मदिवसः अस्ति। तस्मिन् दिने मम गृहे सायं पञ्चवादने लघुः उत्सवः भविष्यति। त्वं मम प्रियं मित्रम् असि, अतः अवश्यम् आगच्छ। सर्वाणि मित्राणि अपि आगमिष्यन्ति। वयं मिलित्वा क्रीडिष्यामः, मोदकानि च खादिष्यामः। शेषं मिलित्वा वदिष्यामि।

तव मित्रम्
रमेशः
questions.explanation: Marks: format (place/date, vocative salutation, greeting) 2; coherent invitation body in correct त्वम् forms 2; closing तव मित्रम् with signature 1.

questions.question: पुस्तकक्रयणाय धनं प्रार्थयितुं पितृचरणयोः कृते संस्कृतेन एकं पत्रं लिखत। (Write a complete Sanskrit letter to your father asking for money to buy books — with proper salutation, greeting, news of studies, the request in honorific plural, and closing.)
questions.answer:
छात्रावासः, वाराणसी
दिनाङ्कः : ०५-०९-२०२६

पूज्याः पितृचरणाः,
सादरं प्रणामाः।

अत्र सर्वं कुशलम्। अहं नियमेन पठामि। आगामिमासे मम अर्धवार्षिकी परीक्षा भविष्यति। परीक्षायाः कृते अहं परिश्रमं करोमि। नूतनपुस्तकानां क्रयणाय धनस्य आवश्यकता अस्ति। कृपया पञ्चशतरूप्यकाणि शीघ्रं प्रेषयन्तु। मात्रे प्रणामाः, अनुजाय स्नेहः। शेषं शुभम्।

भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः
मोहनः
questions.explanation: Marks: salutation पूज्याः पितृचरणाः + सादरं प्रणामाः 1; news of studies 1; request with honorific plural प्रेषयन्तु 2; family greetings and closing भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः 1.

questions.question: ज्वरकारणात् दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशं प्राप्तुं प्रधानाचार्याय संस्कृतेन प्रार्थनापत्रं लिखत। (Write a complete Sanskrit leave application to the Principal for three days' leave due to fever — with सेवायाम्, addressee block, विषयः, salutation, body and formal closing with name, class and date.)
questions.answer:
सेवायाम्
प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः
राजकीयमाध्यमिकविद्यालयः
जयपुरम्

विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्

मान्याः महोदयाः,
सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं ह्यः रात्रौ ज्वरेण पीडितः अस्मि। वैद्यः मह्यं विश्रामस्य परामर्शं दत्तवान्। अतः अहं विद्यालयम् आगन्तुं न शक्नोमि। कृपया दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु।

सधन्यवादम्।
भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः
सुरेशः
कक्षा — दशमी 'अ'
दिनाङ्कः : १२-०८-२०२६
questions.explanation: Marks: सेवायाम् + addressee block 1; विषयः line 1; सविनयं निवेदनम् opening with clear reason 1; request in honorific plural (अनुगृह्णन्तु) 1; formal closing with name, class, date 1.

questions.question: विद्यालयपुस्तकालयस्य सदस्यतां प्राप्तुं प्रधानाचार्याय संस्कृतेन आवेदनपत्रं लिखत। (Write a complete Sanskrit आवेदनपत्रम् to the Principal applying for school library membership, in the full formal format.)
questions.answer:
सेवायाम्
प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः
सरस्वतीविद्यामन्दिरम्
वाराणसी

विषयः — पुस्तकालयसदस्यतार्थम् आवेदनपत्रम्

मान्याः महोदयाः,
सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं दशम्याः कक्षायाः छात्रः अस्मि। मम पठने महती रुचिः अस्ति। अहं विद्यालयस्य पुस्तकालयात् पुस्तकानि नेतुम् इच्छामि। अतः कृपया मह्यं पुस्तकालयस्य सदस्यतापत्रं ददतु। अहं भवतां कृतज्ञः भविष्यामि।

सधन्यवादम्।
भवताम् आज्ञाकारी छात्रः
मोहनः
कक्षा — दशमी 'ब'
दिनाङ्कः : २०-०७-२०२६
questions.explanation: Marks: formal frame (सेवायाम्, addressee, विषयः) 2; polite body with reason and request (मह्यं ददतु — चतुर्थी + honorific plural) 2; closing with name, class, date 1. Feminine forms (छात्रा, आज्ञाकारिणी, कृतज्ञा) equally correct for a girl writer.

questions.question: Describe in detail the parts (अङ्गानि) of a Sanskrit letter, stating what each contains and how the formal letter differs, with examples.
questions.answer: A Sanskrit letter has these parts in order: 1) स्थानम् — the place of writing (जयपुरनगरम्), at the top. 2) दिनाङ्कः — the date, below the place. 3) सम्बोधनम् — the vocative salutation fitted to the recipient: प्रिय मित्र राकेश! (friend), पूज्याः पितृचरणाः (father), मान्याः महोदयाः (Principal). 4) अभिवादनम् — the greeting: सस्नेहं नमस्ते (friend), सादरं प्रणामाः (elders). 5) पत्रशरीरम् — the body: welfare line (अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु), the news/request, and a closing line (शेषं शुभम्). 6) समापनम् — the closing self-description: तव मित्रम् / भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः / भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः. 7) हस्ताक्षरम् — the signature, with class and section in school letters. A FORMAL letter differs by adding, before everything, सेवायाम् with the addressee's designation, institution and place, and a one-line विषयः stating the purpose; its body opens with the fixed सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्..., and its date usually appears near the signature.
questions.explanation: Marks: each part named with its content (up to 3); formal-letter differences with examples (2).

questions.question: 'Letters are of two kinds, and each kind has its own conventions.' Discuss — explain formal and informal letters, their recipients, formats, phrases and tone, giving at least four contrasts with Sanskrit examples.
questions.answer: Informal letters (अनौपचारिकपत्राणि) go to friends and family — मित्राय पत्रम्, पितृचरणयोः पत्रम् — while formal letters (औपचारिकपत्राणि) go to officials and institutions — प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम्, आवेदनपत्रम्. Contrasts: 1) Opening: informal letters begin with place and date only; formal letters begin with सेवायाम् and the addressee block. 2) Subject: only formal letters carry a विषयः line (विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्). 3) Salutation/greeting: प्रिय मित्र! + सस्नेहं नमस्ते or पूज्याः पितृचरणाः + सादरं प्रणामाः (informal) versus मान्याः महोदयाः + सविनयं निवेदनम् (formal). 4) Pronouns/verbs: to a friend the singular त्वम् (आगच्छ); to parents and officials honorific plurals (प्रेषयन्तु, कुर्वन्तु, अनुगृह्णन्तु). 5) Closing: तव मित्रम् / भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः (informal) versus भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः with class and date (formal). 6) Tone and length: informal letters are free, newsy and affectionate; formal letters are brief, respectful and confined to their single purpose.
questions.explanation: Any four well-explained contrasts with correct Sanskrit examples earn full marks.

questions.question: Explain the three grammar devices that Sanskrit letter writing specially needs — सम्बोधन-विभक्ति, चतुर्थी विभक्ति and आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् — with at least six examples from letters.
questions.answer: 1) सम्बोधन-विभक्ति (vocative): used to address the recipient directly; a-stem nouns drop the visarga — सुरेशः → हे सुरेश!, मित्रम् → प्रिय मित्र!; respectful salutations are plural vocatives — पूज्याः पितृचरणाः, मान्याः महोदयाः. 2) चतुर्थी विभक्ति (dative): marks the person TO whom the letter, salutation or gift goes — मित्राय पत्रम्, प्रधानाचार्याय प्रार्थनापत्रम्, मात्रे प्रणामाः, अनुजाय स्नेहः, मह्यं ददतु; नमः always takes चतुर्थी (गुरवे नमः), and purpose uses -अर्थम् (अवकाशार्थम्, सदस्यतार्थम्). 3) आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् (honorific plural): a single respected person is spoken of and to in the plural — भवन्तः, श्रीमन्तः, महोदयाः — with plural verbs: भवन्तः कृपां कुर्वन्तु, प्रेषयन्तु, अनुगृह्णन्तु; whereas a friend takes the simple singular त्वम् आगच्छ. Together these devices let the letter show exactly the right relationship: direct address, correct recipient-marking, and the proper degree of respect.
questions.explanation: Marks: each device correctly explained (1 each = 3); at least six apt examples (2).

questions.question: Write a short Sanskrit letter to your friend describing your new school, using AT LEAST SIX of the useful phrases taught in this lesson (underline or list the phrases you used).
questions.answer:
उदयपुरनगरम्
दिनाङ्कः : १८-०७-२०२६

प्रिय मित्र अर्जुन!
सस्नेहं नमस्ते।

अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु। तव पत्रं प्राप्तम्, पठित्वा महान् आनन्दः जातः। अहम् अधुना नूतने विद्यालये पठामि। विद्यालयः अतीव सुन्दरः अस्ति, तत्र विशालः पुस्तकालयः क्रीडाक्षेत्रं च स्तः। शिक्षकाः स्नेहेन पाठयन्ति। त्वम् अपि एकवारम् आगच्छ। अग्रिमपत्रे अधिकं लिखिष्यामि। प्रत्युत्तरं शीघ्रं देहि। शेषं शुभम्।

तव मित्रम्
विजयः

Phrases used: 1) सस्नेहं नमस्ते; 2) अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु; 3) तव पत्रं प्राप्तम्; 4) पठित्वा महान् आनन्दः जातः; 5) अग्रिमपत्रे अधिकं लिखिष्यामि; 6) प्रत्युत्तरं शीघ्रं देहि; 7) शेषं शुभम्.
questions.explanation: Marks: correct informal format 1; coherent description of the school 2; six or more stock phrases correctly and naturally used 2.

questions.question: Read this letter and answer: 'सेवायाम् / प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः / राजकीयमाध्यमिकविद्यालयः / जयपुरम् // विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम् // मान्याः महोदयाः, / सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं ज्वरेण पीडितः अस्मि। कृपया दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु। / भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः, सुरेशः, कक्षा दशमी।' (a) What type of letter is this? (b) To whom is it addressed? (c) What is requested, and why? (d) Which phrase shows humble submission?
questions.answer: (a) It is an औपचारिकपत्रम् — specifically अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्, a formal leave application. (b) It is addressed to the Principal (प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः) of the Government Secondary School, Jaipur. (c) Suresh requests three days' leave (दिनत्रयस्य अवकाशः) because he is suffering from fever (ज्वरेण पीडितः). (d) सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्... — 'my humble submission is that...' — shows humble submission (with the honorific अनुगृह्णन्तु reinforcing the respect).
questions.explanation: One mark per sub-question.

questions.question: Read this letter and answer: 'मुम्बईनगरम्, दिनाङ्कः : ०२-१०-२०२६ // प्रिय मित्र गोविन्द! / सस्नेहं नमस्ते। / अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु। दीपावली-अवकाशे अहं ग्रामं गमिष्यामि। त्वम् अपि मया सह चल। वयं मिलित्वा उत्सवं मानयिष्यावः। प्रत्युत्तरं शीघ्रं देहि। / तव मित्रम्, हरिः।' (a) Who wrote the letter and to whom? (b) What type of letter is it? (c) What does the writer propose? (d) Which two phrases mark it as informal?
questions.answer: (a) Hari (हरिः) wrote it to his friend Govinda (गोविन्द). (b) It is an अनौपचारिकपत्रम् — an informal letter to a friend. (c) Hari proposes that during the Diwali holidays the two of them go to the village together and celebrate the festival (मया सह चल — 'come with me'). (d) The affectionate salutation-greeting प्रिय मित्र! / सस्नेहं नमस्ते and the closing तव मित्रम् (along with singular त्वम् forms like चल, देहि) mark it as informal.
questions.explanation: One mark per sub-question.

questions.question: Read this extract and answer: 'पूज्याः पितृचरणाः, / सादरं प्रणामाः। / अत्र सर्वं कुशलम्। आगामिमासे मम परीक्षा भविष्यति। पुस्तकक्रयणाय धनस्य आवश्यकता अस्ति। कृपया पञ्चशतरूप्यकाणि प्रेषयन्तु। मात्रे प्रणामाः। / भवतां प्रियः पुत्रः, मोहनः।' (a) Who is the recipient? (b) What is requested and why? (c) Why is the verb प्रेषयन्तु plural though the father is one person? (d) Which word is in चतुर्थी in 'मात्रे प्रणामाः'?
questions.answer: (a) The recipient is the writer's father (पूज्याः पितृचरणाः). (b) Mohan requests five hundred rupees (पञ्चशतरूप्यकाणि) because he needs money to buy books for his coming examination. (c) प्रेषयन्तु is आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् — the honorific plural: out of respect, a single elder is addressed with plural forms. (d) मात्रे — the dative (चतुर्थी) of मातृ, 'to mother' — since salutations are directed TO her.
questions.explanation: One mark per sub-question.

questions.question: The parts of a formal letter are given jumbled: (i) मान्याः महोदयाः (ii) हस्ताक्षरम् — नाम, कक्षा, दिनाङ्कः (iii) सेवायाम् + पदनाम + विद्यालयनाम (iv) सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत्... (v) विषयः — ... (vi) सधन्यवादम्। (a) Write the correct order. (b) Name the part that states the purpose in one line. (c) Name the part where the writer's class appears. (d) Which part is the salutation?
questions.answer: (a) Correct order: (iii) सेवायाम् + designation + school → (v) विषयः → (i) मान्याः महोदयाः → (iv) सविनयं निवेदनम्... (the body) → (vi) सधन्यवादम् → (ii) हस्ताक्षरम् with name, class, date. (b) The विषयः (v) states the purpose in one line. (c) The class appears in the signature block (ii), below the name. (d) मान्याः महोदयाः (i) is the सम्बोधनम् (salutation).
questions.explanation: Order 1 mark; one mark for each identification.

questions.question: A student wrote this letter to her friend: 'सेवायाम् / प्रिया सखि मीरे! / सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् मम गृहे श्वः उत्सवः अस्ति। भवत्यः अवश्यम् आगच्छन्तु। / भवतीनाम् आज्ञाकारिणी छात्रा, गीता।' Identify THREE things that wrongly follow the formal convention in this informal letter, and give the correct informal replacements.
questions.answer: 1) सेवायाम् — the formal opening — has no place in a friend's letter; it should be removed (place and date at the top instead). 2) सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् — the formal submission phrase — should become a warm informal line, e.g. सस्नेहं नमस्ते। अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु। मम गृहे श्वः उत्सवः अस्ति। 3) The honorific भवत्यः... आगच्छन्तु and the formal closing भवतीनाम् आज्ञाकारिणी छात्रा do not suit an equal friend; use the singular त्वम् अवश्यम् आगच्छ and close with तव सखी, गीता। (The vocative प्रिया सखि मीरे! itself is fine for a friend.)
questions.explanation: One mark per error correctly identified; one mark for overall correct informal replacements.

questions.question: Situation: Your elder sister's wedding is on Friday and Saturday, and you need two days' leave from school. Write in Sanskrit: (a) the विषयः line, (b) the सम्बोधनम्, (c) the opening निवेदन sentence stating the reason, and (d) the request sentence with an honorific-plural verb.
questions.answer: (a) विषयः — अवकाशार्थं प्रार्थनापत्रम्। (b) मान्याः महोदयाः, (c) सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् आगामिशुक्रवासरे मम अग्रजायाः विवाहः भविष्यति। (d) अतः कृपया दिनद्वयस्य अवकाशं दत्त्वा माम् अनुगृह्णन्तु। (Any equivalent correct sentences with दिनद्वयस्य अवकाशः and an honorific plural like अनुगृह्णन्तु / कुर्वन्तु are acceptable.)
questions.explanation: One mark per element; the request must use चतुर्थी-appropriate style and a plural honorific verb.

questions.question: Situation: You want to invite your friend Meena to your home for the Deepavali festival. Write in Sanskrit: (a) the सम्बोधनम्, (b) the अभिवादनम्, and (c) one inviting sentence and the closing with signature (use your name as लता).
questions.answer: (a) प्रिया सखि मीने! (b) सस्नेहं नमस्ते। (c) दीपावली-उत्सवे त्वम् अवश्यं मम गृहम् आगच्छ, वयं मिलित्वा दीपान् ज्वालयिष्यावः। Closing: तव सखी, लता। (For a male friend the forms would be प्रिय मित्र... / तव मित्रम्.)
questions.explanation: One mark per element: correct feminine vocative and greeting, an apt inviting sentence with त्वम्, and the informal closing.

questions.question: Sort these six phrases into FORMAL-letter phrases and INFORMAL-letter phrases: सविनयं निवेदनम्, सस्नेहं नमस्ते, भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः, तव मित्रम्, सेवायाम्, अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु।
questions.answer: FORMAL: सविनयं निवेदनम् (humble submission — opening of an application), भवताम् आज्ञाकारी शिष्यः (obedient pupil — formal closing), सेवायाम् (opens the addressee block). INFORMAL: सस्नेहं नमस्ते (affectionate greeting to a friend), तव मित्रम् (friendly closing), अत्र कुशलं तत्रास्तु (welfare line of personal letters).
questions.explanation: Half a mark per phrase correctly classified.

questions.question: Grammar case: (a) Give the चतुर्थी (dative) singular forms of मित्रम्, पितृ and गुरुः. (b) Use any one of them in a complete letter-sentence. (c) Why is the dative the right case for these words in letters?
questions.answer: (a) मित्रम् → मित्राय; पितृ → पित्रे; गुरुः → गुरवे. (b) Example: अहं मित्राय पत्रं लिखामि। ('I write a letter to the friend.') or गुरवे नमः। (c) The dative (चतुर्थी) expresses the recipient/beneficiary — 'to/for whom' — and in letters these persons RECEIVE the letter, the salutation or the नमः; नमः in particular always governs चतुर्थी.
questions.explanation: Forms 1.5 marks (half each); sentence 1 mark; reason 1.5 marks.

questions.question: Read this extract and answer: 'सेवायाम् / प्रधानाचार्यमहोदयाः / सरस्वतीविद्यामन्दिरम्, वाराणसी // विषयः — पुस्तकालयसदस्यतार्थम् आवेदनपत्रम् // मान्याः महोदयाः, / सविनयं निवेदनम् अस्ति यत् अहं दशम्याः कक्षायाः छात्रा अस्मि। कृपया मह्यं सदस्यतापत्रं ददतु। / भवताम् आज्ञाकारिणी छात्रा, मीरा।' (a) What is applied for? (b) Is the writer a boy or a girl — which words show it? (c) Which word is in चतुर्थी meaning 'to me'? (d) Why is ददतु used instead of ददातु?
questions.answer: (a) Library membership — पुस्तकालयसदस्यता (a membership card, सदस्यतापत्रम्). (b) A girl — the feminine forms छात्रा (girl student) and आज्ञाकारिणी (obedient, fem.) show it. (c) मह्यम् — the dative of अहम्, 'to me'. (d) ददतु is the PLURAL imperative — आदरार्थे बहुवचनम् — used because the Principal is addressed with honorific plural forms; the singular ददातु would not show the required respect.
questions.explanation: One mark per sub-question.
